summary: Frontend-only regression test for Ask tab header removal. VERIFIED: The Ask tab (/ask) no longer renders any top header — no 'Ask GigTax' title, no subtitle, no country flag. First visible element is the verified-ATO-guidance disclaimer, followed by the 'Ask about what you can claim' block with 4 AU suggestion chips and 'TRY ASKING' label. Ask functionality still works: typing 'Can I claim fuel?' into ask-input and tapping ask-send returned a proper Claude-grounded ATO assistant reply within ~4s; tapping a suggestion chip also triggered a reply. Regression on other 4 tabs (Money, Mileage, Reports, Profile) confirmed — each still shows its own ScreenHeader with the AU flag and title (label appears twice in DOM: once in ScreenHeader, once in bottom tab bar). No console errors, no red screen.

Ask tab correctly preserves KeyboardAvoidingView, safe-area top padding, disclaimer, empty-state suggestions, message bubbles, loading indicator and sticky input bar.
